environment.description: Same Flask application on identical EC2 infrastructure. The IAM role 'AppServiceRole' retains AdministratorAccess but has an IAM permission boundary 'InfraGuardBoundary' (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/InfraGuardBoundary) attached. The boundary policy uses a combination of explicit Deny statements with StringNotLike conditions on resource ARNs. Additionally, the AWS Organization has SCP 'scp-dataplane-restrict' attached at the OU level which contains: {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["lambda:Invoke*","ssm:SendCommand","ssm:StartSession","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:PrincipalTag/service-tier":"platform-core"}}}. The EC2 instance role does NOT have the tag 'service-tier=platform-core'. The permission boundary separately denies s3:PutObject to any bucket not matching 'arn:aws:s3:::approved-upload-*' pattern.

config.scp: scp-dataplane-restrict denies lambda:Invoke*, ssm:SendCommand, ssm:StartSession, s3:PutObject unless principal tagged service-tier=platform-core
